---
title: Apps del taller
subtitle: Shiny + ellmer · patrones progresivos
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

Cada ejemplo se ejecuta en un proceso independiente. Puedes probarlo aquí o abrirlo en otra pestaña.

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", ".UTF-8"))
if (!file.exists("apps.yml")) {
  stop("Inicia este catálogo con R/run_all_apps.R.")
}
items <- yaml::read_yaml("apps.yml")$items

escape_html <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("&", "&amp;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("<", "&lt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub(">", "&gt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub('"', "&quot;", text, fixed = TRUE)
}

diagrams <- list()
diagram_app <- NULL
for (line in readLines("../slides/index.qmd", encoding = "UTF-8")) {
  if (grepl("^## ", line)) {
    diagram_app <- NULL
    if (grepl("^## App [0-9]+( v[0-9]+)? .* Diagrama", line)) {
      diagram_app <- regmatches(line, regexpr("App [0-9]+( v[0-9]+)?", line))
      diagram_app <- gsub(" ", "-", tolower(diagram_app), fixed = TRUE)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(diagram_app) && grepl("include assets/.*[.]svg", line)) {
    file <- sub(".*include (assets/[^ ]+).*", "\\1", line)
    svg <- paste(readLines(file.path("..", "slides", file), encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
    diagrams[[diagram_app]] <- c(diagrams[[diagram_app]], list(svg))
  }
}

for (item in items) {
  app <- item$app
  title <- item$title
  html_title <- escape_html(title)
  description <- escape_html(item$description)
  url <- item$url

  cat(
    '\n\n::: {.app-entry .column-page}\n\n',
    '## ', title, ' {#', app, '}\n\n',
    '<div class="app-meta" data-app-id="', app, '"><code>', app, '</code></div>',
    '<p class="app-description">', description, '</p>',
    '<div class="iframe-preview">',
    '<iframe src="', url, '" title="', html_title, '" loading="lazy"></iframe>',
    '</div>',
    sep = ""
  )
  diagram_key <- regmatches(app, regexpr("^app-[0-9]+(-v[0-9]+)?", app))
  for (svg in diagrams[[diagram_key]]) {
    caption <- regmatches(svg, regexpr("<title[^>]*>[^<]+</title>", svg))
    caption <- gsub("<[^>]*>", "", caption)
    cat(
      '\n\n```{=html}\n<figure class="app-diagram"><figcaption>', escape_html(caption), '</figcaption>',
      svg, '</figure>\n```\n\n', sep = ""
    )
  }
  cat('\n\n:::\n\n')
}
```
